name: intent-protocol-bch-swap
description: Same-chain BCH/CashToken intent swaps using Dutch Auction and Limit Order contracts

scripts.build:mesh: npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/StrategyCovenant.cash -o artifacts/StrategyCovenant.json && npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/OracleStrategyCovenant.cash -o artifacts/OracleStrategyCovenant.json && npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/MultiPairRecyclingCovenant.cash -o artifacts/MultiPairRecyclingCovenant.json && npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/DutchDecayStrategyCovenant.cash -o artifacts/DutchDecayStrategyCovenant.json && npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/MeshStrategyWithSurplusCapture.cash -o artifacts/MeshStrategyWithSurplusCapture.json
scripts.build: npm run build:mesh && npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/DutchAuctionSwap.cash -o artifacts/DutchAuctionSwap.json && npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/LimitOrderSwap.cash -o artifacts/LimitOrderSwap.json && npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/DutchAuctionSwapWithFee.cash -o artifacts/DutchAuctionSwapWithFee.json && npx.cmd cashc@0.12.1 contracts/LimitOrderSwapWithFee.cash -o artifacts/LimitOrderSwapWithFee.json
scripts.test:mesh: tsx test/StrategyCovenant.test.ts && tsx test/OracleStrategyCovenant.test.ts && tsx test/MultiPairRecyclingCovenant.test.ts && tsx test/DutchDecayStrategyCovenant.test.ts && tsx test/MeshStrategyWithSurplusCapture.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:mesh && tsx test/DutchAuctionSwap.test.ts && tsx test/LimitOrderSwap.test.ts
scripts.test:security: tsx test/LimitOrderSwap.security.test.ts && tsx test/DutchAuctionSwap.security.test.ts && tsx test/Refund.security.test.ts && tsx test/LimitOrderCancelEarly.security.test.ts && tsx test/mesh_test/run_security_tests.ts
